description: One row per mention-level unit. Fields in four groups: provenance, raw text, coding, governance. Source: PDT v1.2 §8.

access_policy.description: Licence / retention condition for this source

author_hash.description: Author name stored as hash only; desensitised before ingest for internal sources

batch_id.description: Links to the sampling log: query terms, community, time window, collection method, exclusion rules

cluster_id.description: Discovery-layer cluster number; null when unclustered

content_role.description: Only user_quote enters the main VOC statistics

dedupe_group.description: Cross-link reposts and duplicate comments grouped; missing author key never implies independent headcount

eligibility_reason.description: Whether included, and the exclusion reason if not

engagement.description: Engagement fields are weights/trend signals only, never satisfaction

evidence_grade.description: Graded per source and batch; filter statistics by grade

intent_id.description: Jev Choice result: top intent ID

intent_probs.description: Jev Choice result: FULL probability distribution, never top-1 only

lang.description: Jev calibration is computed separately per language

product_model.description: Product model for review-type sources; old-model conclusions never apply to a new model

published_at.description: Original publication time; trends use published_at, never collected_at

rating.description: Only for review-type sources; empty for forum posts, never force-filled

raw_text.description: Original text, never rewritten; long posts are split by paragraph with segment numbers kept

raw_text_status.description: Only verifiable quotes enter core statistics

record_id.description: Globally unique ID, generated from batch + sequence number

scores.description: Jev Score results: per-item probabilities and probability-weighted score, e.g. {satisfaction: {probs: [...], weighted: 2.4}}

segment_no.description: Paragraph/segment number within a long post

source_type.description: Search-discovery records and verified-quote records are managed in separate states

source_url.description: Link to the original text; sources without a link use the batch number and note the reason in the sampling log

verified.description: Verified purchase flag, review-type sources only

title: Unified VOC Table Record
